message.content:
An editorial illustration depicts a multi-story building that appears to be undergoing a controlled demolition. The structure has a distinct tiered design with horizontal white and red bands. It is shown with large cracks, falling debris, and massive plumes of white smoke or dust billowing from its base and sides. A thick, circular ring of white smoke or vapor completely encircles the upper portion of the building. The words "KPK" and "Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi" are visible on the building's facade. 

In front of the building, a red and white flag flies from a thin silver pole. The foreground contains the silhouettes of several small cars. The background shows a hazy, gray city skyline under a dark, overcast sky. 

The large word "TEMPO" is positioned at the top in black serif font, with "50 Tahun!" written in script below it. Large black text on the right reads "BABAK AKHIR KPK," followed by a paragraph of smaller Indonesian text. Other headlines at the top include "LABEL TERORIS UNTUK PAPUA" and "POTENSI JUMBO DIGITALISASI ZAKAT." A red vertical bar runs along the left edge. A barcode and QR code are in the bottom left.
